name: Mars 3
tagline: First soft landing on Mars; ~20 s of surface transmission
description: The first soft landing on Mars (December 1971). Began transmitting what would have been a surface image, but contact was lost after ~20 seconds leaving only a featureless grey frame. The global dust storm raging across the planet may have contributed to the early transmission loss.
best_known_for: First soft landing on Mars; ~20 s of surface transmission
